program.title: BEng in Bioengineering
uncertain: total_required_credits is a calculated value: the PDF does not state a fixed total for the major; it is the sum of the required_credits of all groups (using the lower bound for credit ranges such as 3-5, 0-3, 3-4, 1-4).

Several blocks allow alternative course choices (e.g. COMP block, LIFS 1901 exemption, MATH block, PHYS block, BIEN 3310/3320, BIEN 4920/4930/4940), so the actual credits taken by a student may differ from the calculated total.
Remarks in the PDF note that BIEN 4310, CENG 4160 and COMP 1022P were last offered in earlier years and subsequently deleted; they are kept in the lists as printed in the PDF.

The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 BIEN (4Y) (2025-26 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2025-26 intake curriculum rendered on a 2026-27 template; the year is recorded as 2025-26 per the intake year.
